title: Entitled Drunk Woman Crashes And Flips Her Car Then Acts Like A Complete Brat
description:
#cops #police #arrest

On August 20th, 2023 in Wisconsin. Officers were called to a neighborhood in regards to an intoxicated woman who had hit a parked car which resulted in her car being flipped over. When speaking to the officers, she denied drinking earlier and she started acting very entitled. This is footage of the events that followed.
